chars.OUSSAMA: OUSSAMA: a thin Moroccan man in his early 30s, short black hair, light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.RACHID: RACHID: a 5-year-old Moroccan boy with curly brown hair, wearing a red t-shirt with a green dinosaur on it and grey shorts
chars.ASMA: ASMA: a Moroccan woman around 30 with a lilac headscarf and a long teal house robe with white patterns

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Modern Casablanca apartment living room. OUSSAMA sits on the Moroccan sofa next to little RACHID who plays with toy blocks; OUSSAMA suddenly freezes and turns his head sharply toward an open bedroom door down the hall, eyes wide and suspicious, as if hearing a phone ringing somewhere. Comic tense mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: OUSSAMA stands in the living room scratching his head, looking at an old tablet lying on a shelf with a puzzled, relaxed expression, thinking it is his wife's tablet making the noise.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: OUSSAMA tiptoes down a narrow apartment hallway toward a child's bedroom, leaning forward, cupping his ear to follow a sound, cautious and suspicious, dramatic light coming from the bedroom door.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In the hallway OUSSAMA holds the silent tablet in one hand and his own phone in the other, staring at both in shock, mouth open, realizing neither device is the one ringing.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In a colorful child's bedroom OUSSAMA kneels on the floor and pulls open a hidden drawer under the small kid's bed, discovering a strange black smartphone hidden inside, his face shocked.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: OUSSAMA sits on the edge of the child's bed holding the mysterious smartphone, the screen's glow lighting his curious and nervous face, his thumb about to tap, bedroom dim.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Over-the-shoulder view: OUSSAMA scrolls through a photo gallery on the hidden phone full of pictures of little RACHID smiling; RACHID himself peeks curiously from the bedroom doorway in the background.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, ASMA lies in bed in a dim Casablanca bedroom secretly typing on the black smartphone with a sly, loving smile, glancing toward the door to make sure nobody sees her. Secretive mood.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Close dramatic shot: OUSSAMA sitting on the child's bed gripping the hidden phone, face frozen in total shock and anger, sweat on his forehead, while little RACHID stands innocently beside him holding a toy. Cliffhanger mood.
